verdicts.reason: A keeps the purple circle as a backing panel with 'Smart Home' above 'GADGETS' in the right order and readable white text. Flaws: the text is small, the text block sits low-left inside the shape, the dots are cramped, and the frame line is faint. B has the order reversed ('GADGETS' above 'Smart Home'), and the text sits directly on the busy wood and robot image with no panel behind it. The purple shape is shrunk to a tiny fragment at the bottom, the dots and frame are leftovers, and the brand shape is lost, so it is barely usable.
